description: This PHP test class verifies the functionality of the AttendancePunchInRecordOverlapAPI, an API class related to attendance punch-in record overlaps in the OrangeHRM system. It uses PHPUnit-style test methods to ensure API endpoints work as expected, including handling of 'getOne' retrieval and scenarios where other operations are not implemented.
